notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Maskwood Nexus that is a 4/4 Construct with haste named Mishra's Warform.
When Mishra's Warform enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate any number of mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 2/2 Shapeshifter creature token.
When the Shapeshifter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 3.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.
